_doc: Retail-side field spec for the execution+dataflow trace (docs/plans/execution-flow-trace.md). Maps each instrumented engine VA -> the declared payload the Frida agent reads at that call, joined to the port's CALL_TRACE_* fields by (va, field-name). VA keys + global VAs accept 0x-hex or decimal. src: global (read DAT at va) | arg (Frida onEnter arg index, 0-BASED: index 0 = first param) | argderef (deref arg[index] + off) | retval (onLeave) | rngcalls (cumulative LCG-draw count = the agent's g_rng_count_total; auto-installs the LCG hook). type: i32|u32|f32|hex. NB: indices are Frida's standard 0-based InvocationArguments (index 0 = first cdecl param) — validated 2026-06-05 against FUN_00404efc's dst/src/diffuse params.

0x47be92.name: tick_scheduler
0x47be92._note: FUN_0047be92 — the once-per-frame game-loop scheduler root (also the turbo virtual-clock anchor). Carries the per-frame RNG determinism payload that flow_diff --verdict classifies, read at onEnter BEFORE this frame's sim consumes RNG: rng = engine LCG state DAT_006023a0, rngcalls = cumulative LCG draws (src:rngcalls → the agent's g_rng_count_total; auto-installs the LCG hook). Port mirror: src/tick.c CALL_TRACE_BEGIN(0x47be92). Replaces the old --player-pos-log rng/rngcalls columns + the retail --watch path phase_probe.py used.

0x48670f.name: house_update
0x48670f._note: FUN_0048670f — the once-per-frame HOUSE free-roam update (parent of the player + companion controllers; also the 目玉商品 sparkle emitter's prologue). Per-frame ACTOR STATE read at onEnter (frame start, pre-update), mirrored by src/scene1_player_ctrl.c scene1_player_ctrl_tick CALL_TRACE_BEGIN(0x48670f). Player actor 0 + companion actor 2: facing octant + world angle + pos + anim cell. Replaces the old --player-pos-log px/oct/coct/… columns. Pos arrays: actor i at DAT_056da1d8 + i*0xc (x,y,z); actor records at DAT_056daae8 + i*0x2c (ANIM@+0, COUNTER@+0x10, FRAME@+0x14, FACING@+0x18).

fields.name: cgate_c8
fields._note: FUN_0048a833 early-return gate (all.c:89164 `if (DAT_056da1c8 == 1) return;`) — when 1 the companion controller skips ALL state writes incl. facing, so DAT_056dab58 holds its entry seed. Suspect for why retail holds coct=4 (down) in the loaded shop while the port's idle rule overwrites it to 2.

fields.name: cstate
fields._note: DAT_056db048 — companion controller mode (compared ==0xe / ==0xf in FUN_0048a833's branch selection at all.c:89286/89294).

fields.name: cwander
fields._note: DAT_0438be6c — idle-wander state machine (0=idle-countdown,1=wander,2/3=return) in FUN_0048a833.

fields.name: cc08
fields._note: DAT_0438cc08 — the INGAME interaction state machine id inside FUN_0048670f. 1=free-roam walk · 0xa(10)=context-menu commit countdown · 0=open navigable menu · 0xf/0x10=sub-menus · 2=display-management · 0x17=furniture-place · 3=place-confirm · 0x32=counter · 4=customer/scripted. NOTE: during the in-house display-stand REMOVE interaction cc08 stays 1 the whole time — the menu is gated by cc04 (below), NOT cc08. Port var s_cc08 in scene1_player_ctrl.c.

fields.name: cc04
fields._note: DAT_0438cc04 — the cc08==1 free-roam INTERACTION sub-state. 0=walking · 1=in-house display-stand menu (the sword-stand remove/place menu; opened at 0x488d85 ret 0x488d8a, updated by FUN_00469414(1) at 0x48915a ret 0x48915f, closes back to 0) · 2=furniture-grid display-management (flag DAT_0450fee8[fidx]!=0, opened at 0x488c6e). THE shop-display-remove menu is cc04==1 — this is the field the original RE missed (it watched cc08 only). Port var s_cc04 in scene1_player_ctrl.c.

fields.name: b150
fields._note: DAT_0438b150 — the shared choice-box / modal-cursor visible flag (set by FUN_00434def choice_box_open, cleared by FUN_00435612). Drives the PAUSE_OPEN/PAUSE_CLOSE anchors. Tracking it to RE the cc08==4 ESC-skip → first-customer b150 hold (held f461→f1018 in rec-20260622-182618).

fields.name: b5e4
fields._note: DAT_0730b5e4 — the cc08==4 ESC 'Cancelling tutorial?' skip-armed flag (set by FUN_0045e6a5, polled/cleared in the master tick). Port var s_b5e4 in customer_service.c.

fields.name: b74c
fields._note: DAT_0438b74c — proximity/affordance counter, ++ (cap 0xc) in menu-ish states {0,0xa,0xf,0x10,0x1e}, -- otherwise. The `9 < DAT_0438b74c` gate guards menu open + nav (all.c:88151).

fields.name: b754
fields._note: DAT_0438b754 — menu commit countdown; ++ each frame in states 0xa/0x10/0x1e, dispatches the selected action at ==0xf (all.c:86892).

fields.name: cc0c
fields._note: DAT_0438cc0c — context-menu cursor index; up/down nav (LAB_004878f1) clamps mod the menu count; indexes the action-type array DAT_074b2d98[] at dispatch.

fields.name: cd0bc
fields._note: DAT_005cd0bc — context-menu entry count written by FUN_004850fe (populate); the modulus for cc0c nav on the cc08==0/0xa menu.

fields.name: bea4
fields._note: DAT_0438bea4 — selected furniture index for display-management mode 2; FUN_0048940e(bea4,dir) loads/saves that furniture's item grid ↔ scratch.

fields.name: b1e0
fields._note: DAT_0438b1e0 — active save-slot index (the per-slot save-bank stride is *0x2dfc8). Lets the probe resolve slot-relative flags (f406/f404) off-line.

fields.name: b534
fields._note: DAT_0730b534 — the customer-service SELL sub-state (cc08==4): 1 greeting, 2 sell-greeting, 3 item-select, 4 price-setup, 5 first-offer, 6 reaction, 0xf HAGGLE DECISION, 7 accept, 8/0x28 pushback, 9 reject, 0x10/0x11 counter, 0x12 leave, 10/0xb/0xc/0xd closing, 0x14/0x15 queue-advance, 0x1e sold-pause. Owned by FUN_00462403/FUN_00463cfb.

fields.name: b5a8
fields._note: DAT_0730b5a8 — transaction-type selector dispatched at FUN_00462403:60563 (4=SELL/haggle FUN_00463cfb, 1=buy, 0/2/5 other kinds, 3=chat). -1 at session init.

fields.name: b56c
fields._note: DAT_0730b56c — active customer kyaku-record index (record = &DAT_06a5ea90 + idx*0x2c670). Tutorial forces 0xd (kyaku 13 'Woman').

fields.name: b574
fields._note: DAT_0730b574 — the customer's current OFFERED price (haggle math output).

fields.name: b584
fields._note: DAT_0730b584 — haggle round counter (0 = first offer, ++ per round).

fields.name: b590
fields._note: DAT_0730b590 — patience (0..0xf; 0xf forces a decision in FUN_004622d9).

fields.name: ask
fields._note: DAT_005c6bb8 — player's asking price (the input/accumulated number shown in the BARGAIN!! panel).

fields.name: base
fields._note: DAT_005c6bc0 — base/reference price (sum of item DB base prices).

fields.name: b520
fields._note: DAT_0730b520 — leave/dissolve phase (0 active, 1 leaving, 2 dissolving → FUN_004526f5 tile fade).

fields.name: b5a0
fields._note: DAT_0730b5a0 — customer arrival-anim counter (0..0x3c; the enter slide + the '!' bubble emit).

fields.name: b524
fields._note: DAT_0730b524 — the b534==0 idle-state frame counter (++ each idle frame; gates the story-event probe at ==0x32).

fields.name: b544
fields._note: DAT_0730b544 — per-state sub-frame timer (==1 = first frame of a b534 state; resets on every transition).

fields.name: b604
fields._note: DAT_0730b604 — the scripted-machine PC (g_tuto slot index). cs_goto/FUN_004623bc sets it. DIAGNOSTIC: at the tuto2 threshold GOTO does retail's PC stay in tuto2 (slot 50+) or jump back to tuto1 (slot 0-49) like the port?

fields.name: b51c
fields._note: DAT_0730b51c — the SCRIPTED-machine gate. b534==1 && b51c!=0 → FUN_00461c00 (scripted tuto). b51c==0 → the kind machines (FUN_004658ab sell / FUN_00464af0 buy). DIAGNOSTIC: is the buy round scripted or a real kind machine?

fields.name: b5b0
fields._note: DAT_005c6bb0 — the scripted-tutorial SCRIPT-FILE index (fileidx): selects g_tuto[b5b0*200+pc]. Set ONLY by FUN_00461bf6 (push 0 = player-Z sell entry; push 2 = the 3 other entries). The buy thresholds in FUN_00461c00 op5/0xd gate on b5b0==1 (BUY direction) vs else (SELL). DIAGNOSTIC: is the tutorial buy round really b5b0==1?

fields.name: b5bc
fields._note: DAT_005c6bbc — the haggle threshold BASE value (FUN_00461c00 op5/0xd compare fVar5=b5bc vs fVar4=b5b8/ask). Distinct from probe 'base' (0x5c6bc0) and 'ask' (0x5c6bb8).

fields.name: b150
fields._note: DAT_0438b150 — the shared modal-cursor-visible flag (set 1 by choice_box_open FUN_00434def / FUN_0043561a; 0 by FUN_00435612). Drives the PAUSE_OPEN anchor (0→1). DIAGNOSTIC: when does it go 0→1 during the haggle (the 5 'PAUSE_OPEN' episodes)?

fields.name: f404
fields._note: DAT_0450f404[player] — the SELL-ACTIVE flag (player is selling). The buy gold-cap (FUN_0045ff31) gates on b5a8==0 && f404==0. i32 reads the low byte + neighbours; the f404 byte is bit0.

fields.name: gold
fields._note: DAT_044e37a4[player] — player gold. The buy gold-cap clamps the entered offer (b5b8) to this when b5a8==0 && f404==0.

fields.name: b58c
fields._note: DAT_0730b58c — the BARGAIN!! choice-button row state (FUN_00466b7b §4). Probed to see the UI mode in the buy round.

fields.name: b598
fields._note: DAT_0730b598 — the BARGAIN!! banner ramp state (FUN_00466b7b §3).

fields.name: cbfc
fields._note: DAT_0438cbfc — the free-roam HIGHLIGHTED display cell COL (the stand cell the player is adjacent to/facing; -1 = none). Also the cc04==1 menu's target-cell col: the removal writes grid[cbfc + cc00*0x14]. (In the cc04==2 furniture-grid mode FUN_004862e7 drives it.) Observed 4 on the remove trace = back-row col 4 = the x=-1 sword.

fields.name: cc00
fields._note: DAT_0438cc00 — the free-roam HIGHLIGHTED display cell ROW (0 = back row; -1 = none). The cc04==1 removal cell = cbfc + cc00*0x14 into DAT_044f7030 (= save dword 0x4e26 = SAVE_BANK_FIELD_DISPLAY_GRID).

fields.name: camey
fields._note: eye Y (0x73de320) — the camera PITCH. Probe added 2026-06-22 chasing the user-flagged first-customer 'camera angle still wrong' (XZ matches retail, so the divergence is the Y).

fields.name: camly
fields._note: lookat Y (0x73de32c) — with camey sets the camera PITCH/angle.

fields.name: b5d4
fields._note: DAT_0730b5d4 — the customer pose TIMER (counts to 0xf, FUN paired with b5d0). Probed 2026-06-22 for the scold-pose beat (b534==6 reaction).

fields.name: b59c
fields._note: DAT_0730b59c — reaction phase (the b534==6 reaction sub-state). Probed for the scold pose + 集中線 timing.

0x47be2f.name: tick_now_ms
0x47be2f._note: FUN_0047be2f — pure QPC clock read (no game state). The scheduler samples it at a frame position that legitimately differs port↔retail (retail seq1, port seq45) and is doubly irrelevant under turbo's forced virtual clock. Excluded from chain alignment so it can't shadow a real divergence.

0x47b73c.name: input_poll
0x47b73c._note: FUN_0047b73c — the engine's DirectInput device poll (GetDeviceState into the 256-byte key buffer). Under the TAS harness the port SUBSTITUTES this entirely: replay_input_poll/segtrace_input_poll write g_input_state[].buttons directly from the recorded trace, so the real input_poll() (with its CALL_TRACE_ENTER(0x47b73c)) never runs on the port (src/main.c). Retail still calls its real poll. A deliberate harness-substitution structural divergence — both sides receive identical synthetic input by construction and the device read consumes no game RNG. Excluded from chain alignment so it can't shadow real sim-leg divergences. Revisit if a scenario ever depends on engine-side input side-effects.

fields.name: duration
fields._benign_note: Dormant while phase==0 (fade_tick returns early without reading it; src/fade.c:69). Retail's 170 is leftover from the intro→title fade the port skips; port's is 0. Benign ONLY for fade-idle frames — if debugging an ACTIVE fade (phase!=0), drop this mark and scrutinize.

0x404efc.name: render_quad_add
0x404efc._note: FUN_00404efc(param_1=dst* {x,y,w,h}, param_2=src* {l,t,r,b}, param_3=tex* (w@+4,h@+8), param_4=diffuse). Read at onEnter, before the body mutates param_1[2]/[3]. Joins to src/render_quad.c render_quad_add CALL_TRACE_*.

0x405354.name: render_quad_flush
0x405354._note: FUN_00405354 — 2D quad batch flush. vcount = DAT_00647e0c, read at onEnter before the flush zeroes it.

0x49a59e.name: scene_title_sim
0x49a59e._note: FUN_0049a59e — title-screen menu state machine. The salient persisted menu state, read at onEnter from its DAT_096435xx globals (mapping documented in src/scene_title.h). Port-side names + read timing in src/scene_title.c scene_title_sim_default (CALL_TRACE_BEGIN_STUB). The port body is a subset (stub-marked); these INPUT fields must still track retail frame-over-frame — a [data] divergence here flags a skipped engine branch as load-bearing.

fields.name: submenu_state
fields.reason: engine leaves DAT_09643524 set after a submenu back-out (render is cursor_anim-gated); the port clears it at cursor_anim==0 for its input gate — no render/input effect. engine-quirks §102

0x46c320.name: dialogue_tick
0x46c320._note: FUN_0046c320 — opening-prologue dialogue per-frame update (reveal counter + command walk + standee tween). Read at onEnter, BEFORE this frame's tween runs, mirroring the port's emit_dialogue_calltrace in src/scene1_intro_dialogue.c. Fields = standee table entry 5 (base DAT_073a3e70 + 5*0x1c ints = 0x73a40a0): the iv1_1 sliding Tear sprite. Purpose: settle whether the lines-5/44 standee slide-in divergence is a frame-1:1 slide caught off-phase by the text-anchored capture (benign phase) or a real tween-cadence skew — compare st5_y frame-over-frame port vs retail.
